text:
No. 13 Virginia women’s soccer to host La Salle in Thursday matinee
P. V. Crane
The No. 13 Virginia women’s soccer team will continue its season-opening homestand by hosting La Salle on Aug. 20 at 4 p.m. in Charlottesville, with the match serving as the first half of a doubleheader that also features the Virginia men’s team facing UCLA later that evening.
Admission for all home soccer games during the regular season is free. The game will be streamed on ACCNX, part of the ESPN family of networks, and can be accessed through ESPN.com or the ESPN app. Live statistics are available via VirginiaSports.com, and updates can be found on X and Instagram at @UVAWomenSoccer.
After Thursday's match, fans will have an opportunity to attend an autograph session with the women's team outside the field of play behind the south goal.
Virginia moved up to No. 13 in national polls following a pair of home wins over Northwestern (3-1) and Liberty (2-0). Addison Halpern scored opening goals in both matches, including a game-winner against Liberty. Pearl Cecil was named to the U.S. Under-20 Women’s National Team roster for the upcoming FIFA U20 Women’s World Cup in Poland, while Allie Ross is tied with Halpern atop Virginia's points list with four each—Halpern from two goals and Ross from one goal and two assists across two games.
Gio Canali contributed significantly during week one by tallying a goal and an assist in her debut game; she assisted Halpern's opening goal before scoring what proved to be another game-winner herself. Canali was also selected for Brazil's U20 Women’s National Team roster for this year’s World Cup event.
Virginia has played La Salle once previously, securing a 3-0 victory at Klöckner Stadium during the 2010 NCAA Tournament.
